title: User Secret Rotation Boundary
rule: Codex Factory MUST document what to rotate but MUST NEVER rotate secrets for the user

boundary_rules.rule: Codex can IDENTIFY secrets (SSH keys, SECRET_KEY, SMTP passwords, API tokens, DB passwords)
Codex can DOCUMENT rotation steps (which files, which services, rotation commands)
Codex can GENERATE placeholder values for .env.example templates
Codex MUST NOT generate new secret values for production use
boundary_rules.reason: Secrets generated in conversation context are not secure

boundary_rules.rule: Codex MUST NOT execute rotation commands on production servers
boundary_rules.reason: No remote execution; user must run locally

boundary_rules.rule: Codex MUST NOT print any secret values in reports, logs, or outputs
boundary_rules.reason: Outputs may be shared or archived

boundary_rules.rule: Codex MUST NOT store secret values in governance JSONs or verifier outputs

user_checklist_template: 1. Generate new DJANGO_SECRET_KEY: python -c 'from django.core.management.utils import get_random_secret_key; print(get_random_secret_key())'
3. Generate new SMTP app password in email provider settings
5. Change SSH password on server: passwd
6. Set up SSH key-based auth (recommended over password)
7. Remove hardcoded credentials from all deploy scripts
8. Verify deploy scripts work with new credentials
9. Rotate any API keys/tokens found in project
10. Audit: no plaintext credentials remain in any committed file
realworld2_application: P2 generated user rotation checklist; user MUST execute steps 1-10 offline before production deployment
